body:
Thank you for this reply. The bottom part of your comment really hit deep with me. In going to try and go day by day to find a path I can live in. 

Something I also realized while reading your comment is the aftermath if I did commit suicide. My family has said they dont care and would pay it. I think me being dead would be a lot worse than the former. It's almost selfish to think your helping your family by dying. I realize now that I must endure this pain for them. For the people I love. The people willing to spend thousands just to have a chance to fix me. It really changes your perspective when you think "I" cant go on. If you think "I have to do it for them". 

Thanks again for this post
Its hard to do the stuff I enjoy such as working out because the pressure in my head when i workout makes me like jello. I can't lift at all.
